title: Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor and Parkinson’s Disease
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for unilateral or bilateral deep brain stimulation (DBS) for medically refractory tremor in essential tremor and Parkinson's disease (NCD 160.24).
